---
title: "Weekly Sales Report"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
sales <- read.csv("data/sales_sample.csv")
head(sales)
```

## Revenue by region

```{r revenue-by-region}
sales %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(total_revenue = sum(revenue), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_revenue))
```

## Plot

```{r plot-revenue}
sales %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(total_revenue = sum(revenue), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(region, -total_revenue), y = total_revenue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Revenue by Region", x = "Region", y = "Revenue (KES)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

<!-- Tutorial note: knitting this produces report.html — notice it's excluded
     by .gitignore, since rendered output shouldn't be committed. -->
